summary: iter28 — server.py refactor (billing + automations extracted) + industry-aware Dashboard/Settings. Backend: 65/65 tests PASS across iter28 (12), iter27 regression (20), iter10 automations (13), iter19 trial (8), iter9 billing/webhooks/pwa (12, with TestBillingTiers::test_tiers_public deselected per agent-to-agent note). issues: iter28 spec listed CTAs as 'Create CoR plan' (transport), 'Create clinical SOP' (healthcare), 'Create lone-worker plan' (retail) but actual buttons rendered are 'Generate CoR plan', 'Track AHPRA registrations', 'Quick-induct a casual'. Hospitality ('Create HACCP plan') and Trades ('Generate SWMS') match exactly. Healthcare and Retail clearly chose a different primary action than the spec line — this is a coherent design choice (Healthcare starter card focuses on Aged Care Act 2024 / AHPRA register; Retail starter focuses on high-turnover casual induction) but it deviates from the wording E1 listed in features_or_bugs_to_test. Flag for E1 to confirm intent — either update the spec or adjust the CTA copy in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useIndustry.js.

settings-industry-card + settings-industry-select + per-industry options (settings-industry-trades / -hospitality / -transport / -healthcare / -retail) all present and clickable. Selecting an option fires PATCH /auth/me/industry which 200s and persists in MongoDB.
